title: Hayashi Department Store
axis: +X east-southeast along north street facade; +Z south-southwest into block. Public north and east facades meet at northeast chamfer.
source: Protomaps / OpenStreetMap native building polygon and same-ID named department-store POI; local restored exterior photographs.
identityStatus: Named Hayashi Department Store POI and building share ID35184576076528. Article point lies west in the neighboring block; do not choose nearer unrelated11m shop polygons. Northeast chamfer agrees with inspected two-street/corner exterior photos.

controls.rooftopDisposition: Five primary floors plus sixth-floor observation/elevator house and shrine/torii per official city heritage description. Photos show fifth-floor stepped terrace and higher corner observation bay. Exact rear/roof plan and heights remain photographic approximations.

scope: Historic corner department store, horizontal window bands, rooftop shrine and curved corner; exclude neighboring shops.
notes: Native northeast chamfer is a flat diagonal entrance face with rounded shoulders in local photos; do not substitute a cylindrical corner. Four porthole levels flank the corner windows, a small upper observation balcony has five circular rail openings, stepped parapet/coping, two broad street wings with concrete/metal rails and exposed-ground-floor arcade. Rooftop shrine/torii, elevator house and fifth-floor terrace are own-building components; stores/interiors/vehicles/street wires and neighboring bank/shops excluded.
limitations: Quantized native footprint, generic15m map height and dated photos do not establish surveyed facade, floor or rooftop coordinates. Full heights must be recorded as photographic estimates.
